articles.title: Crypto investment firm Keyrock is acquiring bankrupt lender Blockfills
articles.snippet: The Brussels-based digital asset services firm plans to purchase BlockFills months after the Chicago-based company filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy, if a court approves.

articles.title: Strategy’s bitcoin sale sparks a $14 million betting chaos on Polymarket
articles.snippet: The 8-K filing by Strategy Monday disclosed sales for the period May 26 to May 31, but the disclosure was issued on June 1. Polymarket's May 31 contract is sitting at 81% Yes and in review, while bettors argue over whether the onchain transactions or the filing date controls.

articles.title: Michael Saylor's Strategy sold 32 bitcoin for $2.5 million to fund dividend payments
articles.snippet: The 8-K filing Monday says proceeds from the May 26-31 sale, executed at an average price of $77,135 a coin, will fund distributions on Strategy's preferred stock.

articles.title: Elon Musk's SpaceX Warns $1.75 Billion IPO Investors of Potential Future Share Dilution
articles.snippet: SpaceX's amended IPO filing signals the company may issue substantial new shares in future transactions as Elon Musk expands its ambitions.

articles.title: Kalshi Eyes Perpetual Futures for XRP, Solana, Dogecoin—And These Altcoins
articles.snippet: Kalshi moved swiftly to lock down an emerging market for perpetual futures in the U.S., filing to certify a slate of altcoin offerings
